heading: How much have consumer prices risen across the EU?
subheading: In October 2026, consumer prices across the EU were 4.0% higher than a year earlier. Annual inflation ranged from 0.6% in Sweden to 7.0% in Romania.
textNote: Measured by the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP).
title: How much have consumer prices gone up across the EU?
subtitle: In October 2026, consumer prices across the EU were 4.0% higher than the year before. The annual inflation rate ranged from 0.6% in Sweden to 7% in Romania.
